rationale: Quinbrook's current hierarchy defines Primergy as the 100%-owned manager-level portfolio company and Prairie Mist as one of its projects. Primergy likewise presents Prairie Mist as its operating asset. No distinct sponsor-level co-investment, later equity transfer or pending sale was found.
recommendedChanges: Merge/remove the standalone Prairie Mist Solar PortCo record into Primergy Solar.
Preserve Prairie Mist Solar Project, LLC and Amazon Solar Farm Arkansas - Prairie Mist as project/SPV aliases beneath Primergy.
Preserve the 100 MWac Ashley County operating asset, 2021 acquisition year, November 2023 financing and November 2024 commercial operation.
Do not treat the PNC tax-equity affiliate, debt providers, Amazon, North Little Rock, Primoris or Entergy/MISO as manager-level owners.
Do not combine the separate and inconsistent Prairie Mist BESS page with the solar asset without additional verification.
unresolvedQuestions: The seller and exact closing date for the 2021 project acquisition are not publicly disclosed.
The exact Quinbrook fund, holdco and post-tax-equity SPV percentages are not publicly disclosed.
The separate Prairie Mist BESS page cannot be reconciled to the operating solar project from current evidence.
